lead.headline: FirstEnergy's seven utilities still send people to read 2.26 million meters, about 27% of all hand-read US meters
lead.number: 2,260,839 hand-read meters in 2024: about 27% of the US total (30% if EIA's estimated small-utility meters are left out) on 3.8% of all meters; its Ohio, Maryland and West Virginia utilities hand-read 57-83%, every other investor-owned utility there under 5%
lead.watch_out: 2024 only and self-reported; if regulator-approved smart-meter rollouts are underway, this catches FirstEnergy mid-swap: "late", not "refused"
